table.retrieve:
SELECT
	PA.AdmissionCode,
	PA.PatientCode,   
	AdmittedTo=PA.LocationCode,   
	Regno = (SELECT Patient.RegNo FROM Patient 
		WHERE Patient.PatientCode = 
			(SELECT PatientCode 
			FROM PatientAdmission 
			WHERE PatientAdmission.AdmissionCode = :Code)),
	patientname=P.name,
	Patientloction=PL.name,
	patientward=(select name from ward where ward.wardcode=PL.wardcode),
	CurrentLocation = ISNULL((SELECT TargetLocation FROM PatientTransfer WHERE PatientTransfer.TransferCode = (SELECT Max(PatientTransfer.TransferCode) FROM PatientTransfer WHERE PatientTransfer.AdmissionCode = :Code)), (SELECT A.LocationCode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE A.AdmissionCode = :Code)), 
	AdmittedOn=PA.Date,
	AdmittedBy=PA.UserCode,
	PA.DoctorCode,
	PA.Diagnosis,
	PA.Discharged1,
	PA.Discharged1By,
	PA.Discharged1On,
	PA.Discharged,
	PA.DischargedBy,
	PA.DischargedOn,
	PA.Dischargenotes,
	ref1=PA.ref1,
	ref2=PA.ref2,
	ref3=PA.ref3,
	ref4=PA.ref4
FROM
	PatientAdmission PA, Patient P, Patientlocation PL
WHERE
	PA.AdmissionCode = :Code AND
	PA.Patientcode=P.patientcode AND
	PA.locationcode=PL.locationcode
